Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Jim Levin, David Strah, and Christopher Lynn, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2.Discussion about how AIDS affects the classroom and the court room COMMERCIAL:National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights 3. Discussion about convicting a man dying of AIDS who robbed a woman COMMERCIAL:Human Rights Campaign 4.NYC Council nominates Joseph Lisa for Health Committee Chair 5.Washington Countdown, discussion about political candidates and celebrities who are supporting the March on Washington 6. Interview with Susan Cavin and David Harris who talk about Non Violent Civil Disobedience 7.Fundraiser for the March on Washington at The Tunnel COMMERCIAL:National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights 8.News Watch, Initial trials of the drug DDC have been stopped because its too toxic Brendan O'Rourke, an AIDS patient, recieved a hug from Pope John Paul II 9.Anti-Censorship groups have accuseed the National Broadcasting Company for refusing to air a commercial about the US Constitution because of veiled references to abortion and homosexuality 10.GCN Sports, Information about NY Gay Pool League, Interleague meeting regarding gay bowling, and discussion about football strike among other things 11.Lavender Health, Interview with West Cronk, NY Coordinator of the Names Project and NY Steering Committee for the March on Washington 12.Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1.Naming Names, criticism of the appointment of Judge Robert Bork for the Supreme Court COMMERCIAL:The Islanders Club 2.Show Bitz, Discussion about revivial production of "Dreamgirls" COMMERCIAL: Gay Treasures 3.Cindy and Leah talk about The Fetish Ball at The Limelight
